options.name: 显示订阅额度
options.note: 在「今日用量」中显示 Kimi Code 会员的 5 小时、本周、本月额度和加油包余额
options.noteEn: Show your Kimi Code membership's 5-hour, weekly and monthly quota and booster balance under Today's usage
options.optIn: Kimi Code 不在本机记录额度。打开后，Kiteline 将读取 Kimi Code 登录后保存在本机的令牌（~/.kimi-code/credentials 中的文件），每 10 分钟向 Kimi 服务器查询一次额度，与 Kimi Code 中 /usage 显示的一致。令牌仅在本机使用，不会上传，也不会发送到手机。此查询方式并非月之暗面为第三方提供，Kimi Code 更新后可能失效；令牌存放在系统钥匙串时无法读取。
options.optInEn: Kimi Code doesn't record its quota on your computer. When turned on, Kiteline reads the token Kimi Code saves after you sign in (files in ~/.kimi-code/credentials) and asks Kimi's servers for your quota every 10 minutes, the same figures /usage shows in Kimi Code. The token is used only on this computer; it is never uploaded or sent to your phone. This isn't an interface Moonshot AI offers to third parties and may stop working after a Kimi Code update; tokens kept in the system keychain can't be read.

limitsNote: 打开下方「显示订阅额度」后，在「今日用量」中显示 Kimi Code 的 5 小时、本周、本月额度和加油包余额；用自己的 API Key 接其他模型服务时没有额度
limitsNoteEn: Turn on "Show plan quota" below to see Kimi Code's 5-hour, weekly and monthly quota and booster balance under Today's usage; there's no quota when you use your own API key with another model provider
speaker: Kimi
notes: 新接入 Kimi Code：查看会话和完整对话；在 tmux 中运行时可从手机回复、审批命令、回答提问、中断和关闭会话；用量统计计入 Kimi Code 的 token。
notesEn: New: Kimi Code support. View sessions and full conversations; when it runs in tmux, reply, approve commands, answer questions, interrupt and close sessions from your phone. Usage stats include Kimi Code's tokens.
